packs.name: Editorial Freeform
packs.summary: 杂志式自由设计，以非对称构图、留白和重点排版建立节奏，适合产品、品牌、培训与通用汇报。

theme.name: Editorial Freeform
theme.motif: editorial rules, cropped geometry, and asymmetric negative space

layout_principles: Use one dominant idea per page and let whitespace carry hierarchy
Prefer 7:3 or 2:3 asymmetry over uniform card grids
Alternate dense evidence pages with breathing emphasis pages
Use lines, fields and typography before adding containers or shadows

layouts.composition: Oversized headline on the left with a vertical color field and cropped geometric motif on the right
Asymmetric 7:3 evidence and implication split without repeated cards
A strong horizontal or Z-shaped reading path with numbered anchors and generous connective whitespace
One statement or number occupies the visual center; supporting copy is reduced to one narrow column

packs.name: Consulting Signal
packs.summary: 结论先行、数据清晰、页眉与证据区严格对齐，适合管理层、董事会、战略方案与经营分析。

theme.name: Consulting Signal
theme.motif: precise rules, restrained data color, and conclusion-led headers

layout_principles: Every page title states the answer, not the topic
Use one primary visualization and one implication zone
Color carries data meaning; decoration stays neutral
Show comparisons, baselines and source context around important numbers

layouts.composition: Minimal cover with a strong left title rail, date and confidentiality footer
Conclusion header, 72% evidence canvas, 28% implication rail and source footer
One hero metric plus three supporting metrics with flat separators rather than floating cards
Two evidence columns share one baseline and converge into a single recommendation band
Milestones aligned to a common axis with explicit outputs and ownership

packs.name: Keynote Canvas
packs.summary: 以大标题、强视觉锚点和低密度叙事推进故事，适合发布会、路演、产品介绍与培训演讲。
packs.visual_style: bold keynote with cinematic negative space

icon_strategy.rule: large symbols only; no icon lists

theme.name: Keynote Canvas
theme.motif: cinematic fields, oversized numerals, and luminous geometric anchors

layout_principles: Make one object or statement dominate at first glance
Use 40-60 percent negative space on breathing pages
Keep supporting copy to one short sentence or three fragments
Prefer full-canvas composition over nested panels

layouts.composition: Full-canvas field with oversized text and one cropped orbital form
One 120px hero number or phrase with a short interpretation below
Three moments arranged along a Z-path with no enclosing card grid
A bold dividing field separates before and after; the answer crosses the boundary

packs.name: Technical Blueprint
packs.summary: 以深色技术蓝图呈现系统层级与精确连接关系，适合架构说明、AI/软件方案与技术评审。

theme.name: Technical Blueprint
theme.motif: blueprint grid, precise connectors, system labels, and luminous endpoints

layout_principles: Show hierarchy, direction and boundaries before adding explanatory text
Use aligned layers and connectors with semantic endpoint shapes
Keep each system node to a name plus one short responsibility
Use the accent color for active paths and the secondary accent for outputs

layouts.composition: Technical title block over a sparse blueprint grid and one system motif
Three to five horizontal system layers with labeled interfaces
Directional flow with explicit inputs, processors and outputs
Structured matrix with aligned labels and highlighted active cells
One highlighted system node or metric with dependency lines fading into the background

packs.name: Academic Defense
packs.summary: 面向论文答辩、研究汇报和课题申请，强调研究问题、方法、证据与结论的连续性。

icon_strategy.rule: use only for section navigation and methods

theme.name: Academic Defense
theme.motif: academic rules, evidence frames, restrained institutional blue and gold

layout_principles: Move from research question to method, evidence, finding and contribution
Reserve visual space for figures, tables and citations
Use institutional color sparingly and keep data marks neutral
Keep source and method labels visible on evidence pages

layouts.composition: Institutional title block, research subtitle, author metadata and a restrained geometric seal
One research question or hypothesis with a narrow context band
Method stages connected vertically or horizontally with inputs and outputs
Large evidence region, explicit figure caption and one finding statement
Findings align to contribution, limitation and next-work columns

packs.name: AI Ops
packs.summary: 红蓝双轴与模块化分区构成高信息密度企业技术汇报，适合智能运维、数字化转型和平台能力说明。

icon_strategy.rule: number badges identify modules; icons only identify capability types

theme.name: AI Ops
theme.motif: red title anchors, blue module labels, dashed zones, number badges and warm overview bands

layout_principles: Use red for objectives and emphasis, blue for systems and capability modules
Group dense information into named zones before adding detail
Keep one overview band above the evidence canvas
Prefer aligned modules and explicit connectors over decorative cards

layouts.composition: Centered title above a red-blue capability sequence and strong dual-color left rail
Large chapter statement inside a warm overview field with a red numeric anchor
Overview band, three aligned capability zones and a narrow operational footer
Red-blue comparison matrix with one result band below
Numbered operational stages connected across a common horizontal axis

packs.name: Government Blue
packs.summary: 庄重深蓝配合亮青信号线，适合政策解读、重点项目、城市治理、基础设施和正式工作汇报。
packs.visual_style: formal civic blue with modern signal lines

icon_strategy.rule: use restrained line icons for navigation and public-service categories

theme.name: Government Blue
theme.motif: deep-blue title fields, cyan signal rails, numbered sections and restrained civic geometry

layout_principles: Keep the hierarchy formal and the title zone unmistakable
Use cyan only for active signals, progress and high-priority evidence
Pair one broad evidence field with one concise policy implication zone
Avoid ornamental seals, emblems or organization-specific marks

layouts.composition: Deep-blue field with a left signal rail and a wide centered title block
Oversized chapter number and title over a sparse deep-blue field
Numbered title bar, primary evidence canvas and right-side implication rail
Balanced policy comparison with a highlighted recommendation band
Milestones distributed across one bright-blue civic signal path

packs.name: Government Red
packs.summary: 深蓝底、红色秩序线与金色强调形成稳重正式的双轴体系，适合政策、公共事务和重大项目汇报。
packs.visual_style: formal civic red-blue with restrained gold accents

icon_strategy.rule: use simple institutional geometry without logos, seals or flags

theme.name: Government Red
theme.motif: dark-blue anchor fields, red section rails, thin gold signals and formal centered composition

layout_principles: Use red for structure and priority, not as a full-page decorative fill
Reserve gold for one high-value conclusion or milestone
Maintain formal symmetry on anchor pages and disciplined grids on evidence pages
Do not imitate any specific public institution or include official insignia

layouts.composition: Centered statement on a dark-blue anchor field with red and gold perimeter signals
Large chapter numeral at left and a formal centered title axis
Red numbered header above a wide evidence region and concise finding rail
Two formal evidence columns converge into one gold-accented decision band
A red milestone sequence on a restrained dark-blue baseline

packs.name: Medical University
packs.summary: 医疗蓝、生命绿和橙色提示构成可信、清晰的科研与病例汇报体系，适合医院、医学院和健康主题。
packs.visual_style: clean clinical-academic system with life-science accents

icon_strategy.rule: use clinical symbols only when they clarify evidence or workflow

theme.name: Medical University
theme.motif: medical-blue headers, orange safety markers, life-green evidence accents and clinical dividers

layout_principles: Keep methods, evidence, findings and sources visually distinct
Use blue for structure, green for positive biological or outcome signals
Reserve orange for cautions, controls and highlighted assumptions
Give clinical images and charts enough room for captions and provenance

layouts.composition: Clinical blue header, centered research title and a precise evidence divider
Deep medical-blue chapter field with a large numeral and concise subtitle
Clinical header and key-message band above a large figure region and finding rail
Matched cohort or method columns with a shared outcome baseline
Clinical method stages progress across a blue-green pathway with explicit inputs and outputs

packs.name: Pixel Retro
packs.summary: 深空黑、霓虹绿和像素化控制台语言，适合开发者分享、游戏、编程教程和极客文化主题。
packs.visual_style: retro pixel console with restrained neon signals

icon_strategy.rule: use blocky console symbols and status marks; avoid mixed outline icon styles

theme.name: Pixel Retro
theme.motif: pixel rails, console windows, neon status blocks and scanline-like structure without filters

layout_principles: Use neon color as a status signal, not as an all-over glow effect
Keep surfaces rectangular and align them to a visible console grid
Use monospace display type for headings and PPT-safe CJK body type
Recreate glow through solid outlines and layered shapes because filters are forbidden

layouts.composition: Centered console title framed by neon rails and small status controls
Oversized level number and chapter title inside a pixel frame
One primary console surface with a slim status rail and output footer
Pixel-aligned metrics or comparison blocks share one neon baseline
Quest stages advance across a segmented neon path with status checkpoints

packs.name: Psychology Attachment
packs.summary: 蓝绿渐变、稳定边界与温暖语义色构成专业而有亲和力的心理、教育和人文培训模板。
packs.visual_style: warm professional psychology with secure-base structure

icon_strategy.rule: use calm circular or relational symbols with one consistent stroke weight

theme.name: Psychology Attachment
theme.motif: secure boundary rails, nested circles, blue-green relationship fields and warm semantic accents

layout_principles: Use stable boundaries and predictable reading order to support sensitive material
Balance professional blue with healing green and limited warm accents
Use nested circles and relationship lines only when they carry meaning
Prefer calm breathing space over dense decorative card grids

layouts.composition: Centered title inside a calm blue-green field with nested relationship circles
Large chapter statement over a secure-base field with one relational motif
A stable framework region paired with a narrow interpretation column
Semantic categories align in one horizontal family with colored boundary rails
Relational stages move along a gentle blue-green journey with explicit reflection points
